title: Lynn Insulation Rebates 2026: 75% to 100% Off with Mass Save
desc: Lynn insulation rebates for 2026: free Mass Save assessment, 75% off insulation and air sealing, up to 100% for income-qualified homes or whole 1-4 unit buildings.
lead: Almost half of Lynn's homes were built before 1940, and about one in six still heats with oil. Mass Save pays 75% of insulation and air sealing, and up to 100% for some homes.
cards_heading: What insulation rebates pay in Lynn
cards_intro: We re-read MassCEC's weatherization page on October 3, 2026. Mass Save's own site blocks our checks, so its assessment page comes from a July 3, 2026 snapshot. These are statewide Mass Save offers for Mass Save utility customers.

cards.title: Home Energy Assessment
cards.note: In person or virtual. It is the door to every Mass Save insulation offer.

cards.title: Insulation and air sealing
cards.note: The standard Mass Save discount on insulation, air sealing and weather stripping.

cards.title: Income-qualified or whole 1-4 unit building
cards.note: For households that qualify by income, or a 1-4 unit building where all the owners agree to weatherize together.

cards.title: Single-pane to triple-pane windows
cards.note: Listed with the weatherization offers on MassCEC's page.

cards.title: Mass Save HEAT Loan
cards.note: Terms up to 7 years, for your share of the cost.

cards.title: Energy Saver Home Loan
cards.note: At up to 2% for up to 20 years, for income-qualified households.

after_cards:
Working it out

MassCEC's example for a 2,000 square foot home: $4,000 of insulation and air sealing before incentives, $1,000 after the 75% Mass Save discount. If the household qualifies by income, or the home is in a 1-4 unit building where every owner joins in, the cost can drop to zero. The 0% HEAT Loan can spread the rest over up to 7 years.
sections: The US Census Bureau's survey (2020 to 2024) counts 37,960 homes in Lynn. About 46% were built before 1940 and 78% before 1980. Some 35% are single-family detached and 33% are in two- to four-unit buildings. About 48% of households own.

About 17% of Lynn households heat with fuel oil. Oil is one of the costliest ways to heat, so every bit of heat you keep in counts. Insulation and air sealing are the cheapest way to cut that bill, and they come before a heat pump if you plan one.
How the Mass Save insulation offer works

You don't apply for an insulation rebate on your own. You book a free Home Energy Assessment with Mass Save, by phone at 866-527-7283 or online. An energy specialist looks at your attic, walls and basement, and recommends work. If you go ahead, a Mass Save contractor does it, and the discount comes off the bill. You don't pay full price and wait for a cheque.

Renters and landlords can book an assessment too. A renter can get the visit, but the owner signs off on insulation. Mass Save also has a separate track for buildings with five or more units.
installers_intro: Ranked by Google reviews (minimum five). We don't take referral fees or paid placements. Mass Save's discount applies when the work goes through a Mass Save assessment and contractor, so confirm that with any company before you sign.
claim_heading: How to get insulation rebates in Lynn
claim_steps: Book a free Mass Save Home Energy Assessment online or at 866-527-7283.
If you might qualify by income, say so when you book. It can raise the discount to 100%.
If you own a unit in a 1-4 unit building, ask the other owners to join. Doing the whole building together can also reach 100%.
Let the energy specialist recommend the work, then pick a Mass Save contractor.
Pay your share after the discount, or use the 0% HEAT Loan.
faq: How much does Mass Save pay for insulation in Lynn?
75% off insulation, air sealing and weather stripping as standard. Up to 100% for income-qualified households or 1-4 unit buildings where all owners agree to one project.
Can I use a 0% loan for my share in Lynn?
Yes. The Mass Save HEAT Loan offers up to $25,000 at 0% over terms of up to 7 years.
Is the Mass Save home energy assessment really free?
Yes. Mass Save offers a no-cost assessment in person or by video, plus a no-cost online assessment.
Can renters get Mass Save insulation?
Renters can book the free assessment. The building owner has to agree to any insulation work.
Does Mass Save help with windows?
Only in one case on MassCEC's list: $75 per window for replacing single-pane windows with triple-pane windows. Insulation and air sealing get the larger discount.
